[Source: Yogasutra.janvier. 2020.pdf, éd. 2021.pdf | Section: Yoga-Sūtra III.44 (Vibhūtipāda) — Sthūlasvarūpasūkṣmānvayārthavattvasaṃyamādbhūtajayaḥ | Pages 651-658]

ādayo viśeṣāḥ
/ Tathā ca–uktam-- eka-jāti-samanvitānām eṣāṃ dharma-mātra-vyāvṛttir iti / Sāmānya-
viśeṣa-samudāyo'tra dravyam / Dvi-ṣṭho hi samūhaḥ / Pratyastamita-bheda-avayava-
anugataḥ śarīraṃ vṛkṣo yūthaṃ vanam iti / Śabdena–upātta-bheda-avayava-anugataḥ
samūhaḥ-- ubhaye deva-manuṣyāḥ, samūhasya devā eko bhāgo manuṣyā dvitīyo bhāgaḥ /
Tābhyām eva–abhidhīyate samūhaḥ / Sa ca bheda-abheda-vivakṣitaḥ / Āmrāṇāṃ vanaṃ
brāhmaṇānāṃ saṃghaḥ, āmra-vanaṃ brāhmaṇa-saṃgha iti / Sa punar dvi-vidho yuta-siddha-
avayavo'-yuta-siddha-avayavaś ca / Yuta-siddha-avayavaḥ samūho vanaṃ saṃgha iti /
Ayuta-siddha-avayavaḥ sa
